record_title: A single Walsh-Hadamard family refutes Talagrand's operator-cotype bound for every finite q
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result is for finite q>=2; it does not address q=infinity or prove optimality of the (log n)^(1/q) separation. The originality claim is restricted to the simultaneous all-finite-q extension for Wu's Walsh-Hadamard family, to the best of our knowledge; older operator-cotype literature may contain an equivalent implication under different terminology.
